chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim [from his father] from Salih ibn al-Sindi from Ja'far ibn Bashir from Ali ibn Abi Hamza from Abu Baseer from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

A youth from the Ansar came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and complained to him of neediness. So he (peace be upon him) said to him: 'Marry.' The youth said, 'I am too shy to return to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).' Then a man from the Ansar caught up with him and said, 'I have a beautiful daughter, so marry her to him.' He said: 'So Allah expanded (sustenance) upon him.' He said: 'So the youth came to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and informed him. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'O group of youths! Upon you is marriage.'
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of marriage according to the hadith of the youth from the Ansar?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Prophetic encouragement of marriage as a means to secure *rizq* (sustenance), illustrating how divine provision expands following the fulfillment of this Sunnah. The narrative underscores the practical wisdom of accepting matches from companions to overcome social hesitation, a theme central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the facilitation of marriage for youth. It serves as a foundational text linking marital status directly to spiritual and material blessings.
